summary: writeVerdict emits pretty-printed plain JSON at .2119/verdicts/<reviewId>.json, and pass/fail/init all route through ensureReviewStorageRules, which re-appends a last-wins .gitignore block (!.2119/, .2119/reviews/, !.2119/verdicts/, !.2119/verdicts/**) plus repairs to any nested .2119/.gitignore and .2119/verdicts/.gitignore; empirically verified in two scratch repos whose .gitignore files already contained '*' and '.2119/' (and nested '*' at both levels) that the recorded verdict is untracked-not-ignored (git check-ignore exit 1) and stages with git add, while .2119/reviews stays ignored.
